title: Remove Commit Panel From Non-Commit Flows
description: There is a bug that a commit panel (Workflow panel with Dismiss/Commit) is showing in flows such as procedural 3d. Remove it so it only appears where commit is appropriate.
summary: Removed the broken SpotlightOverlay commit panel from FlowGraphCanvasHost. It was incorrectly bound to OutputPreview sink summaries (e.g. `{3 keys}`), so Dismiss/Commit appeared on every flow with preview data including procedural 3d. Preview content continues to render on the canvas Preview widget.
